role: Author isolated optional-grant-bound followup; runtime validation and independent replay remain parent/reviewer-owned
baseline: P2-2 v2 plus frozen direct-hit-followup and parent documentation clarification
production_change: Store::revalidation_base preflights the actual complete routed conditional object. If its optional protocol encoding is invalid/oversized it returns no base before dispatch, so this same authorized call fetches one full representation. Public Worker bounds and unsolicited-304 rejection stay unchanged.
regressions: Legal 3500-byte final URI and 1024-byte ETag: cache proof <=8192 and aggregate HTTP metadata <=16384 but grant >8192; cache hit remains valid and explicit refresh sends one full GET with neither conditional field
Bounded read_many of the same case reports 2 known HTTP requests and 21 consumed bytes, no unknown/reserved request grant and one physical Worker dispatch
Unsolicited 304 without the declined grant is rejected once; old metadata/body unchanged and the old TTL still expires normally
